title: Earnings Have Been "Armor" to Tolerate Yields: Bordlemay

title: Goldman's Bordlemay Sees `Ping-Pong' Pattern for Stocks
summary: Katherine Bordlemay, co-head of client portfolio management at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, expects to see a ``ping-pong of volatility'' continue in US stocks even as major indexes grind higher. Stocks rose and bond yields fell as Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said he’d be willing to support holding rates steady if price pressures continue to show signs of easing.

title: Chicago Projects $882 Million Budget Gap on Bond, Pension Costs

title: Not Getting Signs of Overheating from Any Labor Market Indicators, Says Darda
summary:
A recent plunge in US labor force participation has sparked competing theories about whether persistent drivers — like aging and immigration — or more temporary seasonal shifts are to blame. Any evidence in upcoming jobs reports could reshape how policymakers view the labor market.
Michael Darda, Chief Economist at Roth Capital Partners, discusses nominal GDP and outlook for the US economy ahead of Friday's jobs report. (Source: Bloomberg)
